statements.sql:
SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "CategoryID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "CategoryID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."Category"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "AdID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "AdID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."AdsInfo"
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "LocationID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "LocationID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."Location"
UNION ALL
SELECT 3 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "SearchID") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SearchID" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."SearchInfo"

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN("SearchDate") as min_date,
  MAX("SearchDate") as max_date
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."SearchStream"

SELECT "AdID"
FROM "{catalog}"."{schema}"."AdsInfo"
SAMPLE ROW (10000 ROWS)
WHERE "AdID" IS NOT NULL

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "IsClick", "SearchDate"
FROM TMP
JOIN "{catalog}"."{schema}"."SearchStream"
  ON "AdID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "SearchDate" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "SearchDate" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "SearchDate" <= ?
AND "SearchDate" > ?
